description: Provenance metadata for the committed GRPO training plots in this directory. Generated alongside loss_curve.png, reward_curve.png, and baseline_vs_trained.png by training/train_grpo.ipynb.

plots.loss_curve.png: GRPO loss per logged step from trainer.state.log_history
plots.reward_curve.png: Mean reward per logged step from trainer.state.log_history
plots.baseline_vs_trained.png: Random-baseline vs GRPO-trained agent over 5 episodes x 15 steps on the optimization task; baseline uses uniform sampling from the action space, trained uses temperature=0.3 greedy-ish decoding

reproduce.instructions: Open training/train_grpo.ipynb in Colab (T4 16GB or larger). Cells execute top-to-bottom; the final cells regenerate the three plots in this directory.
reproduce.hardware_used: Colab T4 (16 GB VRAM) - matches the 3B model + 4-bit + LoRA config above

notes: Switching to 7B requires changing MODEL_NAME in Cell 4 to 'unsloth/Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct-bnb-4bit' and running on A100/H100 (>=24GB VRAM).
The reward function (Cell 6) is also re-exported from methanol_apc_env.trl_bridge for use outside the notebook.
Wandb is not used in this submission; trainer.state.log_history is the source of truth for the curves.
